<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013012025-05-2118-06-28" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="D Conclusive verses (209b3-210a3)"/>
         <lg><l>rigs pa'i dbang phyug rgol <lb n="209b4"/> ba ngan 'joms thub pa'i dbang pos lung bstan gang ||</l> <l>ston pa'i bstan la mkhas pa'i ming rgyal dag gis ma smad zing ||</l> <l>'jug yul kun la rang lugs 'dzin skye bo kun kyi dbang gyur pa'i ||</l> <l>bla med de ni gling mchog 'di na <lb n="209b5"/> chos rje lta bur grags pa yin ||</l></lg>
         <lg> <l>mtha' gnyis myed par gsum du 'khor zhing ||</l> <l>mi bzad sdug bsngal rtag ldan ba ||</l> <l>thabs myed nyid dang thabs gzhan dag gis shin tu zhi bar mi nus la ||</l> <l><lb n="209b6"/> blo gros snying po gzig nyid de yang gang zhig myed par mi 'byung pa'i ||</l> <l>rigs tshul 'di ni thar pa'i lam la mi snang pa seng ge yin |</l> </lg>
         <lg><l>gsum las bskyed de khyad par rnam bcad pas ||</l> <l>tshad ma'i ngo bo gangs <lb n="209b7"/> dang brjod pa la ||</l> <l>log rtogs brgyal phrag bsal nas rigs pa'i don ||</l>  <l>rnam pa res pa'i thub pa'i rgyal mtshan yin ||</l> </lg>
         <lg><l>mdo' don gang la byed don brgyas ldan pa don gyi gang ||</l> <l><lb n="209b8"/> rab sbyar pa skye bo'i sgra blo'i yang dag ldan rnams kyis ||</l> <l>rnam par bshad pa che 'bris bsdus pa'i 'od dag gis ||</l> <l>rang gi phyogs su zla 'od tsam zhig snang bar kyag ||</l></lg> <lg><l>de nas ring nas smon lam <pb n="210a"/><lb n="210a1"/> stobs kyis 'di 'ongs ste ||</l> <l>gang ri'i skye bo blo gyi myig ldan pa stong dag gis ||</l> <l>phyogs cig blo yis gzhung dang don gyis cha shas las ||</l> <l>spyad mi rim pa don tshul rgya mtsho' gnyis ma 'gyur ||</l> </lg>
         <lg><l><lb n="210a2"/> du mtha' thos ma rnam spyad blo gros can ||</l> <l>dpal ldan dge' slong seng ge'i sgra can gyis ||</l> <l>dab gas goms dang gzhan la phan don du ||</l> <l>smad kyi rnams bshad de bas so ||</l> </lg>
         <lg><l>bsod nams 'di yis 'di la rab brten nas |</l> <l><lb n="210a3"/> brtson ldan blo gros dman pa'i skye bos kyang ||</l> <l>rnam par nges pa nges ste shes bya'i ||</l> <l>de nyis myur du rtogs nas grol 'gyur yin ||</l></lg></seg></TEI>
